name: Deprecated function usage
description: Flags calls to compiled-in deprecated functions or project functions marked `; @deprecated`, and recommends supported alternatives where available.
definition: Flags calls to functions listed in `shared/rules/data/deprecated-functions.yaml`, using the severity and migration guidance supplied by that data, as well as project functions marked `; @deprecated` on the function header or the comment line immediately above it. Native singleton functions must be qualified by their declaring script, while object methods and project declarations are resolved case-insensitively. This rule is enabled by the strict and standard presets and disabled by the careful preset.
